name: PrusaLink, Status
description: Live print monitor for an Original Prusa printer over PrusaLink: printer state, job progress with time left and finish time, nozzle and bed temperatures, and the slicer's preview of the model. Talks to the printer on your own network; no Prusa account needed.

cell_options.name: title
cell_options.label: Title
cell_options.help: Leave empty to use the name the printer gives itself.

cell_options.name: hero
cell_options.label: Lead with
cell_options.help: Model preview fills the card with the slicer's picture of the part, with progress as a bar underneath. Falls back to the ring when the file has no picture.

cell_options.name: show_preview
cell_options.label: Show the model preview
cell_options.help: The picture your slicer saves inside the file, shown beside the ring at the two larger sizes.

settings.name: base_url
settings.label: Printer address
settings.help: The printer's address on your network, for example http://192.168.1.50. Prefer the IP address: a name like prusalink.local often can't be looked up from inside Docker or Home Assistant.

settings.name: username
settings.label: Username
settings.help: maker on a printer with PrusaLink built in. On a Raspberry Pi PrusaLink, the username you chose when setting it up.

settings.name: password
settings.label: Password
settings.help: On a printer with PrusaLink built in: Settings, Network, PrusaLink on the printer's screen. On a Raspberry Pi PrusaLink: the password you chose when setting it up.

settings.name: api_key
settings.label: API key
settings.help: Optional, and enough on its own without a username and password. On a Raspberry Pi PrusaLink it is under Settings, API key.
